content:
sarah: Heads-up — i've opened a small PR that updates the release notes + changelog snippets for the next deploy. need a quick sweep of SDK examples (py/js), one Known Issue entry for streaming fallback, and any broken anchors fixed before noon PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5278

jordan: grabbing the js + py snippets now. curious whether we should show the short form or the full `responses.stream` example for the changelog — short might be easier in the email blurb.

mike: spotted an issue in the python snippet: still references `max_tokens`. v2 clients expect `max_tokens_per_call`. will push a tiny patch.

ananya: i'll run a link/anchor scan across the migration guides. saw one bad anchor on the latency tuning page (`#latency-opts` -> header now `Latency tuning and knobs`) so that needs a redirect anchor or header rename.

sarah: good catch. for Known Issues keep it concise: one bullet about streaming fallback to polling if node eviction happens. also add a note about partial deltas possibly arriving out-of-order.

mike: pushed fix for python: changed to `max_tokens_per_call` and added a short comment about token billing. diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5278/files#diff-abc123

jordan: ran the js example local — swapped the deprecated callback style for `await client.responses.stream()` and added a tiny function-calling snippet. verified on staging.

# error we hit before fix (python):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "snippet_demo.py", line 18, in <module>
    resp = client.chat.create(model="rwd-moderate", max_tokens=256)
TypeError: create() got an unexpected keyword argument 'max_tokens'
```

jordan: after mike's change the sample runs and streaming output looks correct. preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/pr-5278 (build #1509)

ananya: anchors patched plus fixed two sidebar-relative links that 404ed. left a tiny migration note in `v1->v2 kv cache` to call out changed header names.

sarah: i'm drafting the release note blurb — aim for 3 lines for the changelog + one-sentence note for the announcements channel. jordan can you draft the announcement copy?

jordan: suggested announcement copy (ready to paste):
"Release: API client updates and docs cleanup. Notable: updated SDK snippets (Python/JS) for v2 param names, migration guide link fixes, and a Known Issue: streaming may fallback to polling during node eviction; apps should handle partial or reordered deltas. See full notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog#5278"

sarah: that reads well. schedule for 17:00 PT in #announcements. i'll merge after the preview build finishes.

deploy-bot: preview build succeeded — https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/pr-5278 (build #1509) :white_check_mark:

sarah: merged. if anything slips, open a hotfix PR and tag the docs triage. thanks all.

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: will paste announcement at 17:00 PT.

ananya: leaving a brief entry in the changelog under "Known Issues" and linking to the migration guide note. thanks!
